_doc: Quantisation settings used by scripts/export_onnx.py (values copied from the code). Input: merged fine-tuned model (LoRA D) exported to ONNX FP32.

common.lm_head: untied from the embedding before quantisation so both are quantised
common.state_tensors_dtype: float32 for FP32/INT8/INT4 (KV cache + Mamba state), float16 for FP16

fp16.method: weights written into the reference onnx-community fp16 graph (generic float16 converter breaks the Mamba If-subgraphs)

int8.embedding: int8 with per-row scale (Gather -> Cast -> Mul), custom step _int8_embedding()
int8.command: python scripts/export_onnx.py quant --src models/onnx/ft_fp32 --out-root models/onnx --prefix ft

int4.command: same quant command as int8 (both are produced)
